''See also: [[Great Elders Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Great [[Elders]] are a group of immensely powerful, eternal, and alien entities known to some as [[Class One Fiends]]. Though they are often viewed as malicious or even actively evil, many consider them to be strange benefactors whose alien nature and incompatible ways make their kindness potentially lethal to humanity. They possess vast knowledge and powers that exceed human control, often utilizing containers rather than direct contact to manifest their abilities. While they frequently pursue conflicting individual goals and rarely encounter one another, they share a singular ultimate objective: to escape their current world through a [[crack in the sky]] and ascend beyond it. This world is viewed by them as a prison, and they seek to reclaim what was once theirs. There are several known Great [[Elders]], each with a distinct purpose and domain. [[Kelarac]], also known as the Collector of Souls, was a famous bargainer who traded wishes for items such as artifacts, [[blood]], or sanity. Other identified [[Elders]] include Ach'magut{{!}}Ach’magut, who seeks knowledge; [[Nakothi]], who pursues a balance of life and death; [[Urg’naut]], the Elder of Annihilation, who seeks nothingness; Tharlos, the Formless Legion{{!}}Tharlos, who pursues change; and [[Kthanikahr]], who desired to replace humanity with [[worms]]. While they were once defeated in a massive conflict roughly fifteen hundred years ago, it is believed that they do not truly die but merely sleep, capable of eventually gathering themselves to rise again. Humanity interacts with the [[Elders]] through various factions. The [[Blackwatch]] is known to capture and study their biology, while a group called the [[Sleepless]] seeks to communicate with them to gain wisdom for the benefit of mankind. Some believe that having a leader on the [[Imperial]] [[throne]] is necessary to negotiate with these immortals on equal footing. Despite their perceived threat, it is noted that they can be killed when they take human form.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Great [[Elders]] are powerful, mobile entities that utilize the void for both communication and transportation. They possess broad influence through a global network of devices used to amplify [[Intent]], and the [[Optasia]] serves as a conduit to this group. While they set the stage for specific events, their conflicting goals often drive them to task individuals like [[Jerri]] with killing others. These entities are capable of coring and replacing a person, and they remain significant enough that the Emperor can respond to them via the [[Optasia]]. Because of their nature, humanity requires someone capable of negotiating with them on their own terms, a factor that [[Calder]] takes into consideration.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Great Elders]] are powerful entities that the Emperor could respond to using the [[Optasia]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c4">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Great Elders]] have broad power and access to a global net of devices that amplify [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c6">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Great Elders]] often have conflicting goals.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Humanity needs someone who can deal with the [[Great Elders]] on their terms.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Great Elders]] might task [[Jerri]] with killing [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Great Elders]] are entities that move.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|[[Calder]] considers the wishes of the [[Great Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Great Elders]] are a group that the [[Optasia]] acts as a conduit to.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The Great [[Elders]] are powerful entities who were defeated nearly fifteen hundred years ago and once had the Emperor serving them. Although legends suggest there are six such beings, they do not die in the manner of humans and possess the ability to gather themselves to potentially wake from death. While the Emperor avoids discussing this group, the [[Optasia]] provides a means to negotiate with them on an equal level. Currently, these entities seek to destroy The Empire{{!}}the Empire, though Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin has managed to unravel more of their ancient secrets than any other human.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin has unraveled more ancient secrets of the [[Great Elders]] than any other human.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|There are six other [[Great Elders]] according to old legends.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Great Elders]] are a group that the Emperor avoids talking about.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c15">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Optasia]] allows for the understanding and negotiation of [[Great Elders]] on an equal level.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Great Elders]] are powerful entities that were defeated almost fifteen hundred years ago.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Great Elders]] do not die like humans; they can gather themselves and potentially wake from death.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Great Elders]] are beings that the Emperor once served.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c18">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Great Elders]] want to destroy The Empire{{!}}the Empire.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c21">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Great [[Elders]], who were once involved in the [[Elder War]], are currently awake and attempting to escape their world of imprisonment. While a [[false Emperor]] once delivered people to them, they are now known to have left a [[crack in the sky]] through which they intend to ascend. Although they possess strong servants and may seek human vessels, there are superstitions regarding the direct naming of these beings. Despite their weak security and the fact that they were previously fought by Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin and the Emperor, only four Great [[Elders]] remain. Because of their movements and potential to pass through the sky, Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss seeks to protect people from them, as they must be kept sealed.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">17</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[false Emperor]] would deliver people to the [[Great Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c1">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 1</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Great Elders]] are involved in the upcoming meeting.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Shera]] reports that the [[Great Elders]] are moving.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Emperor and Jorin Curse-breaker{{!}}Jorin had fought the [[Great Elders]] together.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c7">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|There are superstitions about naming [[Great Elders]] directly.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c8">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The security on the [[Great Elders]] has been weak.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Great Elders]] may be watching the place closely.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Great Elders]] left a [[crack in the sky]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c11">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss seeks to protect people from the [[Great Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c13">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Great Elders]] want to pass through the [[crack in the sky]] to ascend beyond this world.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Great Elders]] may seek human bodies or vessels.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Great Elders]] were involved in the [[Elder War]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Great Elders]] possess strong servants.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Great Elders]] need to be kept sealed.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|There are four remaining [[Great Elders]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Great Elders]] are awake.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Great Elders]] are attempting to leave the world in which they are imprisoned.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Great [[Elders]] are the true enemies who exist in a manner beyond human understanding. They are currently gathering strength and planning an unknown scheme, having previously cracked open the sky to create an opportunity. While they aim to escape the world and might attempt to force unification or seize control by possessing a single ruler, their involvement signals that no good ending is possible. Although they possess the power to kill every major leader in The Empire{{!}}the Empire, they are vulnerable and can be killed when in human form. To maintain security against them, the [[Guilds]] typically cooperate, as they are capable of opposing these entities during emergencies.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">15</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Great Elders]] are the true enemies.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Great Elders]] might be trying to force unification.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Great Elders]] do not live as humans understand it.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c3">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Great Elders]] are capable of killing every major leader in The Empire{{!}}the Empire.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Great Elders]] are planning something.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The involvement of [[Great Elders]] means there will be no good ending.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Great Elders]] could take over the world by taking over one person on the [[throne]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Great Elders]] can be opposed by the [[Guilds]] in times of emergency.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
